_about: NHTSA child-seat recalls since 2010: the 69 campaigns marked recall type C (child seat) in NHTSA's public daily recall file FLAT_RCL_POST_2010 (https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/ffdd/rcl/FLAT_RCL_POST_2010.zip), downloaded 2026-10-25. One row per campaign; brands and models are every make/model line NHTSA lists for it. Public government data, no family data.
